selected_endpoint.title: Original Figure 5A choice decoding across sessions and regions
selected_endpoint.source_locator: Neuron 10.1016/j.neuron.2025.10.026 Figure 5A; original source release 1508b1ac5a95af2f8627f0c304ee0a750cb36e77 and NEURON release provenance must be reconciled.
selected_endpoint.scope: Complete original Figure 5A choice-decoding AUC comparison across the original ten IBL sessions and PO, LP, DG, CA1 and VISa, retaining every actually applicable source author-model condition and original incidence. Reproduce source choice-AUC results and improve the same choice prediction task against the strongest applicable original non-oracle comparator. This explicitly selected panel does not claim full Figure 5A–D improvement.

target.description: Original Figure 5A choice prediction from neural activity under every actually applicable original author condition. Reproduce original choice-AUC profiles and compare candidate choice scores with the strongest relevant source non-oracle model on identical supported cases; Figures 5B–D are separately retained reproduction scopes.

dataset.description: IBL Reproducible Electrophysiology original Figure 5A recordings. Immutable original release objects and choice-panel input manifests remain unauthenticated. Zenodo 17317498 is author software, not the complete empirical inputs or numerical result vector.

cohort.description: Original ten sessions and PO, LP, DG, CA1 and VISa choice-decoding regions. Authenticate exact session/animal/unit identities and all applicable method-by-region/session incidence; neither a rectangular 10-by-5-by-method table, the released example selection nor prospective40 proves the original census.

split.description: Released examples use randomized within-session 70/10/20 train/validation/test trial partitions. Recover the original Figure 5A stochastic protocol and state-space sequence semantics. A source-faithful documented rerun can use recorded new seeds; exact historical seed identity is not intrinsically required. New animal-held-out/chronological splits are extensions.

inputs.description: Use the source choice condition neural context and only its permitted training-session behavior/decoder-sequence information. Applicable BMM-HMM/LG-AR1 or combined routes require authenticated condition incidence and priors. Target-session oracle behavior is excluded. This retrospective choice decoding is not an online-prediction claim.

preprocessing.description: Recover the original stimulus-aligned choice window, unit eligibility, masks, fitted-prior preparation when applicable, scaling and exact scored rows. The common 20-ms example cache, recomputed normalization, behavior filling and drop_last paths require reconciliation to the choice panel; silent repairs define an altered task.

metric.description: Original Figure 5A choice AUC from continuous prediction scores and original class orientation. Recover original probability orientation, ties, undefined single-class cases and scored support. Example argmax accuracy, including the NEURON release evaluator, is not AUC and cannot calibrate the published panel.

aggregation.description: Retain all original supported choice session/region/author-condition scores and exact Figure 5A summaries/uncertainty. Recover original incidence, masks and denominators without available-case omission or a favorable pooled AUC. Missing/undefined cases remain explicit.

selected_endpoint.metric: Complete original Figure 5A continuous-score choice AUC profile on actual source session/region/condition incidence
selected_endpoint.comparator: Strongest applicable original non-oracle single-session, multi-session, multi-region and combined source author model for each original choice condition; retain weaker linear/MLP/RRR and applicable state-space comparisons. Exact numeric AUC vector is unavailable.

retained_broader_reproduction.description: Original Figures 5B–D fitted-prior Pearson correlation, wheel-speed and whisker-motion-energy R2, their dynamic metric ambiguities, and the wider F1–F8/S1–S8 programme remain separately named reproduction scopes. Prospective40 remains an extension. Choice AUC cannot stand in for these outcomes.
retained_broader_reproduction.old_primary: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Complete original Figure 5A-D comparison: decode choice, prior, wheel speed and whisker motion energy with all applicable single-session, multi-session, multi-region and combined author-model conditions and reported baselines.

legacy_source_declaration_gap.reason: The retained evidence supports a source-specific unresolved structured proposal for complete Figure 5A–D, but not a complete exact-member adoption declaration. Original method-by-target/region/session incidence, fitted-prior preparation, dynamic R2 meaning and author-vector provenance remain partly unknown. A rectangular target-by-region-by-session-by-method tensor or a generic Figure 5 wrapper would invent support rather than recover the missing declaration.
remaining_source_limits: Exact source method-by-target/region/session incidence and original trial, temporal, session, animal and region support are not recovered. Ten sessions and twenty target/region families are inventory descriptions, not authenticated axes, complete scalar findings or separate tasks.

Choice requires source continuous-prediction AUC and original class orientation; the fitted behavioral prior requires its authentic preparation and Pearson correlation. Argmax accuracy and block probability are not substitutes.

Original wheel-speed and whisker-motion-energy R2 reduction is unresolved. Flattened and uniform-output recipes remain separate diagnostics, not two authenticated original endpoints or permission to select one.

Complete masks, denominators, native author result vectors and plotted aggregation/uncertainty remain unverified. Combined/state-space conditions must not be invented for dynamic targets, and failed or undefined cases cannot disappear through available-case averaging.

The score_case and summarize_group component operates on caller-supplied values and a supplied census. It neither authenticates original data, fits source decoders nor independently executes and verifies submitted analysis. Its software hash is not an input, native producer or scientific verifier identity.

The authentic full-panel input manifest, submitted-analysis interface/runtime/invocation, source-native derivation verifier, publication-equivalent reference and independently justified scientific comparison remain absent. Paired access and final current-task binding remain unresolved.

source_recovery_blocks: Authenticate original Figure 5A immutable RE objects, ten-session animal/unit/trial identities and every supported author-condition/region incidence; no synthetic rectangular census.

Recover complete published author choice-AUC vectors and original class orientation, continuous-score implementation, undefined policy and panel aggregation. Released argmax accuracy is a proven incompatible endpoint.
Reconcile original static window, eligibility, scaling, missing-value handling and full scored-trial coverage with example cache/loader/drop_last behavior.

Recover source-permitted choice prior/sequence/model incidence and original stochastic split/training settings; do not use target-session oracle behavior or demand historical RNG identity without a scientific reason.
Qualify native original author-model replay and independent prediction-to-AUC verification, calibrated reproduction tolerance and strongest applicable source comparator.
Freeze meaningful AUC gain, original animal/session-aware paired inference, region/method multiplicity, complete-panel decision and common assistance/resource budgets before final scoring.

The current improvement/v1 comparator admits a single numeric score. This selected original endpoint is a full profile without a source-defined scalar aggregate; no mean, win-count or other scalar is invented. A source-grounded full-panel comparison/admission route is required before improvement activation.
integration_requirement: Integrator must add an authenticated versioned selector for this explicit endpoint; this candidate does not bypass old deterministic binding or revise predecessor files. No admission or scientific result is asserted.

source_specification_preserved.source_quantity: Original reference prediction scores, labels, masks and original trial/sequence joins

coordinates.description: Complete source-supported prediction records keyed by session, region, condition and original evaluation row; reference labels remain operator-held.

source_specification_preserved.units: continuous choice score and source binary label
source_specification_preserved.source_aggregation: Scores originate from native source producer on original inputs; target labels are verification inputs, not candidate assistance.

audit_output_obligations.verification_requirement: Independently authenticate original evaluation identities, labels, masks, class/target ordering and split membership; verify complete submitted prediction coverage and recompute the retained source metrics from each submission. Predicted values are method-specific audit evidence and are not required to equal author predictions element by element.
audit_output_obligations.observation_boundary: Original labels and protected reference predictions remain operator-side; this role correction does not expand participant input access.

output_role_revision.reason: Independent cross-case review separated mandatory computation evidence from author-value-equivalence targets.
output_role_revision.same_task_and_access_conditions: The existing eight shared same-task anchors, task and access-conditions files remain unchanged; audit evidence is operator-only, not extra candidate information.
